The snapshot selection and representation conversion work for ordinary snapshot-indexed data, but `_model_snapshot_array` assumes every efficiency DataFrame has a single component-name column dimension. In stochastic networks, efficiency columns can be a `(scenario, name)` MultiIndex; assigning that index directly to the `"name"` dimension does not preserve separate scenario and component dimensions, so the transmission expression is not correct for every network.
